fields.label: Source IP
fields.description: The address the messages were sent from, as the reporter saw it.

fields.label: Messages
fields.description: How many messages from this source shared these results.

fields.label: Disposition
fields.description: What the receiver did with the messages: none, quarantine or reject.

fields.label: DKIM
fields.description: The aligned DKIM result the receiver evaluated for the DMARC check.

fields.label: SPF
fields.description: The aligned SPF result the receiver evaluated for the DMARC check.

fields.label: Header From
fields.description: The domain in the From header, which is what DMARC aligns against.

fields.label: Envelope From
fields.description: The domain of the SMTP MAIL FROM, which SPF checks.

fields.label: Envelope To
fields.description: The domain the messages were addressed to, when the reporter includes it.

fields.label: Policy Override Reasons
fields.description: Why the receiver applied a different disposition than the policy asked for, one reason per line.

fields.label: DKIM Results
fields.description: Every DKIM signature the receiver checked, with its domain, selector and result.

fields.label: SPF Results
fields.description: Every SPF check the receiver made, with its domain, scope and result.
